record.paper_title: Ball-Evans approximation problem: recent progress and open problems
record.context_brief: Weak versus strong closure of homeomorphisms
record.original_question: Let Ω, Ω′ ⊂ R^n be bounded open sets with n ≥ 3. Define Hom(Ω, Ω′)_w to be the class of maps f ∈ W^{1,p}(Ω, Ω′) that arise as weak W^{1,p} limits of homeomorphisms from Ω onto Ω′, and define Hom(Ω, Ω′)_{||·||_{W^{1,p}}} to be the class of strong W^{1,p} limits of such homeomorphisms. Is it true that Hom(Ω, Ω′)_w = Hom(Ω, Ω′)_{||·||_{W^{1,p}}} in dimensions n ≥ 3?

evidence.quote: Hom(Ω, Ω′)_w := { f ∈ W1,p(Ω, Ω′) : there are homeomorphisms fk from Ω onto Ω′ with fk → f weakly in W1,p }.
where Hom(Ω, Ω′)_{||·||W1,p} and Diff (Ω, Ω′)_{||·||W1,p} denote the class of strong limits of homeomorphisms and diffeomorphisms in the W1,p norm.
Open problem 7. Weak and strong closure of homeomorphisms for n ≥ 3: Let n ≥ 3, is it true that Hom(Ω, Ω′)_w = Hom(Ω, Ω′)_{||·||W1,p}?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n \geq 3$ and let $\Omega, \Omega' \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ be bounded open sets. Fix $1 \leq p < \infty$. Define the following two subclasses of $W^{1,p}(\Omega, \Omega')$:

1. The weak closure of homeomorphisms,
$$\operatorname{Hom}(\Omega,\Omega')_w := \bigl\{\, f \in W^{1,p}(\Omega,\Omega') : \exists\, \text{homeomorphisms } f_k : \Omega \to \Omega' \text{ with } f_k \rightharpoonup f \text{ weakly in } W^{1,p}\,\bigr\}.$$

2. The strong (norm) closure of homeomorphisms,
$$\operatorname{Hom}(\Omega,\Omega')_{\|\cdot\|_{W^{1,p}}} := \bigl\{\, f \in W^{1,p}(\Omega,\Omega') : \exists\, \text{homeomorphisms } f_k : \Omega \to \Omega' \text{ with } \|f_k - f\|_{W^{1,p}} \to 0 \,\bigr\}.$$

Decide whether the equality
$$\operatorname{Hom}(\Omega,\Omega')_w \;=\; \operatorname{Hom}(\Omega,\Omega')_{\|\cdot\|_{W^{1,p}}}$$
holds for all bounded open sets $\Omega, \Omega' \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ in dimensions $n \geq 3$.
artifact.status_search_result: In the planar case ($n=2$), the weak and strong closures of Sobolev homeomorphisms coincide (Iwaniec–Kovalev–Onninen, and Campbell–Hencl–Tengvall). For $n \geq 3$ the problem is listed as an open problem in recent surveys on the Ball–Evans approximation problem; no proof of equality nor a counterexample appears to be known. Related partial results in higher dimensions concern weak limits in $W^{1,n-1}$ and the (INV) condition, but the equality of weak and strong closures in dimension $n \geq 3$ remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: The weak and strong closures of Sobolev homeomorphisms are the same
status_evidence.snippet: Result establishing equality of weak and strong closures of Sobolev homeomorphisms in the planar case.
status_evidence.claim: The planar (n=2) case of the question is settled affirmatively.

status_evidence.title: Ball–Evans approximation problem: recent progress and open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open problems including the equality of weak and strong closures of homeomorphisms for n ≥ 3.
status_evidence.claim: The equality of weak and strong closures for n ≥ 3 is explicitly stated as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Weak Limit of Homeomorphisms in W^{1,n-1} and (INV) Condition
status_evidence.snippet: Studies properties of weak limits of homeomorphisms in higher dimensions but does not establish equality of weak and strong closures.
status_evidence.claim: Higher-dimensional results address weak limits but do not resolve the closure equality.
